verdict.rationale: Insomnia's docs reference a dedicated testing feature (chaining requests, CLI-driven test automation, running tests across collections) implying support for writing assertions, but no evidence explicitly describes assertion syntax targeting response status, body, or headers. A community comment even flags Insomnia's scripting/glue-code support as weak compared to Postman, suggesting the assertion experience may be limited. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of assertion API/methods for status/body/header checks, and independent hands-on confirmation that these assertions work reliably.
